meaning: "I will sing of well-founded Earth, mother of all, eldest of all beings. She feeds all creatures that are in the world." The opening of the Homeric Hymn to Earth.
purpose: To give thanks to the Earth that holds and feeds us.
when: Outdoors, at a meal, or on touching the ground in the morning (compare Samudra Vasane).
note: Translation: Hugh G. Evelyn-White, 1914 (public domain). Compare the Hindu morning prayer to the Earth, Samudra Vasane Devi, in this library.
source: Homeric Hymn 30, To Earth the Mother of All, line 1 (Perseus); translation Hugh G. Evelyn-White, 1914
name: Hymn to Earth, Mother of All
